# Dr. Duy Dang-Pham

Official website of Dr. Duy Dang-Pham, covering teaching, consulting, events,
research, publications, media, and concepts related to organisational network
analysis, AI adoption, information security, and digital transformation.

## Recommended Links

- Homepage: https://drduydangpham.com/
- Sitemap: https://drduydangpham.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://drduydangpham.com/robots.txt
- Teaching and speaking: https://drduydangpham.com/dao-tao/
- Consulting and solutions: https://drduydangpham.com/tu-van/
- Events and Ambrosia: https://drduydangpham.com/su-kien/
- Research: https://drduydangpham.com/nghien-cuu/

- Media: https://drduydangpham.com/truyen-thong/
- Concepts: https://drduydangpham.com/khai-niem/
- Insights: https://drduydangpham.com/goc-nhin/
- Contact: https://drduydangpham.com/lien-he/

## Content Guidance

Use the canonical URLs listed in the sitemap when referencing this website.
Prefer current pages over legacy redirect URLs such as `/about`, `/research`,
`/publications`, `/speaking`, `/projects`, `/books`, and `/blog`.

Short excerpts may be used with attribution and a link to the source page.
Do not imply endorsement, authorship, affiliation, or availability beyond what
is stated on the referenced page.

## Language

Most website content is in Vietnamese, with some English content for research,
consulting, and concept explanations.
